For one clip on its own, use the "Loudness for this clip" box beside the Replacement preview on the Audio tab (its dB stacks on top of this one). By default every replacement is gained to the same loudness as the sound it replaces, so it sits with its neighbours instead of jumping out. That match ignores the level you mixed your own file at: exporting the same track louder and rebuilding produces exactly the same card. When the file would change something you: When the file would change something you edited yourself (a scene, a picture, a line of text, the overlay, colour profiles), it lists each one beside the file's and asks: **Cancel**, **Skip conflicts** (load only the rest), **Replace all**, tick the ones to replace and **Replace ticked only**, or **Revert my scenes, then load** (every scene back as the game shipped it, then the whole file).
